meta.revisionPolicy: Quick estimates are revised in subsequent releases. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: Financial-year average index and growth on a year earlier, as published: General, sectoral, use-based and 2-digit industries
meta.note: Discontinued base (1994–2011) — superseded by 2004-05=100; plotted separately, never spliced (base-year rule). Uses the older 5-way use-based scheme (Basic Goods, no Infrastructure/Construction). Financial years (April to March), dated at April of the first year. Levels and growth are MoSPI's own annual rows (frequency=Annually), not recomputed; the first year of a base has no growth.
